style: A single game sprite for a calm top-down puzzle game, in the pixel art of a classic 1990s Windows puzzle game: drawn on an exact 32 by 32 pixel grid with every pixel a clearly visible square block, a crisp 1-pixel dark outline, a small limited palette with simple shading lit from the top left, no anti-aliasing, no text, no frame or border, centered, on a flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) background. The sprite shows:

generated.ball-red: a glossy red ball seen from slightly above, with a bright highlight at the top left, filling about 80 percent of the canvas.
generated.ball-blue: a glossy blue ball seen from slightly above, with a bright highlight at the top left, filling about 80 percent of the canvas.
generated.ball-green: a glossy green ball seen from slightly above, with a bright highlight at the top left, filling about 80 percent of the canvas.
generated.crate: a sturdy square wooden crate seen from directly above, light brown planks with a darker brown frame and a cross brace, filling about 90 percent of the canvas.
generated.home: a small cozy cottage seen from slightly above, with a jade green roof, cream walls and a warm lit doorway, filling most of the canvas.
generated.teleporter: a round grey stone teleporter pad with glowing light blue concentric rings, seen from directly above, filling about 85 percent of the canvas.
generated.plate: a round orange pressure button set in a grey stone ring, seen from directly above, filling about 70 percent of the canvas.
generated.gate-closed: a closed gate seen from directly above: a square grey stone frame filled with five vertical dark brown wooden bars, filling the whole canvas.
generated.gate-open: one single open gate seen from directly above: a square grey stone frame with an empty dark slot in its middle where the wooden bars were lowered into the ground, filling the whole canvas.
generated.paint-red: a small irregular splash puddle of bright red paint, seen from directly above, filling about 70 percent of the canvas.
generated.paint-blue: a small irregular splash puddle of bright blue paint, seen from directly above, filling about 70 percent of the canvas.
generated.paint-green: a small irregular splash puddle of bright green paint, seen from directly above, filling about 70 percent of the canvas.
generated.star: a chunky golden yellow five-pointed star block with a thick outline, filling about 85 percent of the canvas.
generated.apple: a shiny green apple with a small brown stem and one leaf, filling about 70 percent of the canvas.
generated.reverse: a round light blue token with two opposite white arrows on it, seen from directly above, filling about 70 percent of the canvas.
generated.ammo: one dark iron cannon ball with a small top-left highlight, filling about 70 percent of the canvas.
generated.charge: a round dark token with a bright yellow lightning bolt on it, seen from directly above, filling about 70 percent of the canvas.
generated.target: a round red and white archery target board with a red bullseye, seen from the front, filling about 85 percent of the canvas.
generated.puck: a round grey stone puck with a small glowing light blue lamp in its middle, seen from directly above, filling about 80 percent of the canvas.
generated.key: a golden key lying diagonally, filling about 75 percent of the canvas.
generated.lock: a golden padlock with a dark keyhole, filling about 75 percent of the canvas.
generated.slide: a round light blue token with a white ice crystal snowflake on it, seen from directly above, filling about 70 percent of the canvas.
generated.sensor-closed: a small square grey stone block with a glowing red lamp on top, seen from slightly above, filling about 75 percent of the canvas.
generated.trail: a lilac painted ring mark on the ground with a short lilac line through it, seen from directly above, filling about 70 percent of the canvas.
generated.projectile: a small dark iron ball flying to the right with a short pale motion trail, filling about 50 percent of the canvas.
generated.player: Shovey, a round bright green ball creature with a glossy highlight. Seen from directly above, as in a top-down game: we look down on the top of its round body, and it faces the top of the canvas. Its two big round eyes sit at the top front edge of its body and look up toward the top of the canvas, so we see them from above; no mouth or face looking at the viewer. Filling about 85 percent of the canvas. Keep the body continuous, without a dark interior circle.
generated.charge-engraved: only a lightning bolt engraved into pale grey stone, no floor around it: a slim zig-zag groove about 27 pixels tall, dark grey on its top-left inner edges, light grey on its bottom-right inner edges, its inside slightly darker than pale grey paving, with four bright yellow spark pixels near its lower end; calm, not glowing.
generated.reverse-arrows: clean green four-way arrows: a plus-shaped cross whose four arms each end in an outward arrowhead, mid green with a 1-pixel dark green outline and light green highlights from the top left, about 80 percent of the canvas, with no circle, disc or token behind it.

note: The original Google Flow player is preserved in native/player.png. Only its dark interior ring was removed by a manual pixel edit; its shape, eyes, highlight, outline and outer shading are unchanged. The build rotates it for the other directions and adds the existing charged halo. Do not refit or redesign this kept player. Other raw pictures can be fitted with pixel.py fit.
